title: त्रिचत्वारिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Duryodhana enters the city amid praise, and Karna, embracing him, vows not to wash his feet until he has killed Arjuna. Hearing of this vow through spies, Yudhishthira is troubled, thinking of Karna's armour and might.
summary.kn: ಸ್ತುತಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನು ನಗರ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕರ್ಣನು ಅವನನ್ನು ಅಪ್ಪಿಕೊಂಡು ಅರ್ಜುನನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುವವರೆಗೆ ಕಾಲು ತೊಳೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಗೂಢಚಾರರಿಂದ ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕರ್ಣನ ಕವಚ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನೆದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಚಿಂತಿತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: स्तुतियों के बीच दुर्योधन नगर में प्रवेश करता है, और कर्ण उसे गले लगाकर प्रतिज्ञा करता है कि अर्जुन को मारने तक वह अपने पैर नहीं धोएगा। गुप्तचरों से यह प्रतिज्ञा सुनकर युधिष्ठिर कर्ण के कवच और पराक्रम को सोचकर चिन्तित होते हैं।
summary.te: స్తుతుల మధ్య దుర్యోధనుడు నగరంలో ప్రవేశిస్తాడు; కర్ణుడు అతనిని కౌగిలించి అర్జునుని చంపే వరకు కాళ్లు కడుక్కోనని ప్రతిజ్ఞ చేస్తాడు. గూఢచారుల ద్వారా ఈ ప్రతిజ్ఞ విని కర్ణుని కవచం, పరాక్రమం తలచుకొని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు చింతిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: புகழ்மொழிகளுக்கிடையே துரியோதனன் நகரில் நுழைய, கர்ணன் அவனைத் தழுவி அர்ஜுனனைக் கொல்லும் வரை கால் கழுவ மாட்டேன் என்று சபதம் செய்கிறான். ஒற்றர்கள் மூலம் இச்சபதத்தைக் கேட்டுக் கர்ணனின் கவசத்தையும் வலிமையையும் எண்ணி யுதிஷ்டிரர் கவலையுறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: പ്രശംസകൾക്കിടയിൽ ദുര്യോധനൻ നഗരത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നു; കർണ്ണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്ത്, അർജുനനെ വധിക്കുംവരെ കാൽ കഴുകില്ലെന്ന് പ്രതിജ്ഞ ചെയ്യുന്നു. ചാരന്മാരിലൂടെ ഈ പ്രതിജ്ഞ അറിഞ്ഞ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ, കർണ്ണന്റെ കവചത്തെയും ശക്തിയെയും ഓർത്ത് വ്യാകുലനാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.243; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
प्रविशन्तं महाराज सूतास्तुष्टुवुरच्युतम् ।
जनाश्चापि महेष्वासं तुष्टुवू राजसत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: As he entered, great king, bards praised the unfailing one, and the people praised that best of kings, the great archer.

verses.text:
लाजैश्चन्दनचूर्णैश्चाप्यवकीर्य जनास्तदा ।
ऊचुर्दिष्ट्या नृपाविघ्नात्समाप्तोऽयं क्रतुस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Scattering parched grain and sandalwood powder, they said, "By good fortune, king, your sacrifice has ended without obstacle."

verses.text:
अपरे त्वब्रुवंस्तत्र वातिकास्तं महीपतिम् ।
युधिष्ठिरस्य यज्ञेन न समो ह्येष तु क्रतुः ।
नैव तस्य क्रतोरेष कलामर्हति षोडशीम् ॥

meaning.en: But other mischievous men said to the king, "This sacrifice is not equal to Yudhishthira's; it is not worth a sixteenth part of that one."

verses.text:
एवं तत्राब्रुवन्केचिद्वातिकास्तं नरेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदस्त्वब्रुवंस्तत्र अति सर्वानयं क्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: So some malicious men spoke to the king, but his friends said, "This sacrifice surpasses all others."

verses.text:
ययातिर्नहुषश्चापि मान्धाता भरतस्तथा ।
क्रतुमेनं समाहृत्य पूताः सर्वे दिवं गताः ॥

meaning.en: Yayati, Nahusha, Mandhata and Bharata performed this sacrifice and went purified to heaven.

verses.text:
एता वाचः शुभाः शृण्वन्सुहृदां भरतर्षभ ।
प्रविवेश पुरं हृष्टः स्ववेश्म च नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these kind words of his friends, bull of the Bharatas, the king entered the city and his house in joy.

verses.text:
अभिवाद्य ततः पादौ मातापित्रोर्विशां पते ।
भीष्मद्रोणकृपाणां च विदुरस्य च धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: Then, lord of men, he saluted the feet of his mother and father, of Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and wise Vidura.

verses.text:
अभिवादितः कनीयोभिर्भ्रातृभिर्भ्रातृवत्सलः ।
निषसादासने मुख्ये भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः ॥

meaning.en: Greeted by his younger brothers, he who loved his brothers sat on the foremost seat, surrounded by them.

verses.text:
तमुत्थाय महाराज सूतपुत्रोऽब्रवीद्वचः ।
दिष्ट्या ते भरतश्रेष्ठ समाप्तोऽयं महाक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: The charioteer's son rose and spoke to him, great king: "By good fortune, best of Bharatas, this great sacrifice is complete.

verses.text:
हतेषु युधि पार्थेषु राजसूये तथा त्वया ।
आहृतेऽहं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वां सभाजयिता पुनः ॥

meaning.en: When the sons of Pritha are killed in battle and you perform the Rajasuya, best of men, I will honor you again."

verses.text:
तमब्रवीन्महाराजो धार्तराष्ट्रो महायशाः ।
सत्यमेतत्त्वया वीर पाण्डवेषु दुरात्मसु ॥

meaning.en: The famous King Dhritarashtra's son replied: "That is true, hero, with the Pandavas, evil souls.

verses.text:
निहतेषु नरश्रेष्ठ प्राप्ते चापि महाक्रतौ ।
राजसूये पुनर्वीर त्वं मां संवर्धयिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: When they are killed, best of men, and the great sacrifice, the Rajasuya, comes, hero, you will exalt me again."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाप्राज्ञः कर्णमाश्लिष्य भारत ।
राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं चिन्तयामास कौरवः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the wise Kaurava embraced Karna and thought of the Rajasuya, best of sacrifices.

verses.text:
सोऽब्रवीत्सुहृदश्चापि पार्श्वस्थान्नृपसत्तमः ।
कदा तु तं क्रतुवरं राजसूयं महाधनम् ।
निहत्य पाण्डवान्सर्वानाहरिष्यामि कौरवाः ॥

meaning.en: That best of kings said to the friends beside him, "When shall I perform that great, costly best of sacrifices, the Rajasuya, Kauravas, after killing all the Pandavas?"

verses.text:
तमब्रवीत्तदा कर्णः शृणु मे राजकुञ्जर ।
पादौ न धावये तावद्यावन्न निहतोऽर्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: Karna said to him: "Listen to me, elephant among kings. I will not wash my feet until Arjuna is slain."

verses.text:
अथोत्क्रुष्टं महेष्वासैर्धार्तराष्ट्रैर्महारथैः ।
प्रतिज्ञाते फल्गुनस्य वधे कर्णेन संयुगे ।
विजितांश्चाप्यमन्यन्त पाण्डवान्धृतराष्ट्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the great archers and great warriors, Dhritarashtra's sons, shouted, as Karna vowed in battle to kill Phalguna, and thought the Pandavas already conquered.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनोऽपि राजेन्द्र विसृज्य नरपुंगवान् ।
प्रविवेश गृहं श्रीमान्यथा चैत्ररथं प्रभुः ।
तेऽपि सर्वे महेष्वासा जग्मुर्वेश्मानि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana too, O king, dismissed the best of men and entered his home, glorious like the lord at Chaitraratha. All those great archers went to their houses, Bharata.

verses.text:
पाण्डवाश्च महेष्वासा दूतवाक्यप्रचोदिताः ।
चिन्तयन्तस्तमेवार्थं नालभन्त सुखं क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, great archers, stirred by the messenger's words, brooded on that very matter and found happiness nowhere.

verses.text:
भूयश्च चारै राजेन्द्र प्रवृत्तिरुपपादिता ।
प्रतिज्ञा सूतपुत्रस्य विजयस्य वधं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Again, king of kings, spies brought the news of the charioteer's son's vow to kill Vijaya, Arjuna.

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा धर्मसुतः समुद्विग्नो नराधिप ।
अभेद्यकवचं मत्वा कर्णमद्भुतविक्रमम् ।
अनुस्मरंश्च संक्लेशान्न शान्तिमुपयाति सः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing it, the son of Dharma was greatly disturbed, thinking Karna's armor unbreakable and his valor wonderful, and remembering their hardships, he found no peace.

verses.text:
तस्य चिन्तापरीतस्य बुद्धिर्जज्ञे महात्मनः ।
बहुव्यालमृगाकीर्णं त्यक्तुं द्वैतवनं वनम् ॥

meaning.en: As he was consumed with worry, the great-souled one decided to leave the Dvaitavana forest, which was full of many beasts and snakes.

verses.text:
धार्तराष्ट्रोऽपि नृपतिः प्रशशास वसुंधराम् ।
भ्रातृभिः सहितो वीरैर्भीष्मद्रोणकृपैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: King Dhritarashtra's son ruled the earth with his brothers and heroes Bhishma, Drona and Kripa.

verses.text:
संगम्य सूतपुत्रेण कर्णेनाहवशोभिना ।
दुर्योधनः प्रिये नित्यं वर्तमानो महीपतिः ।
पूजयामास विप्रेन्द्रान्क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: Meeting Karna, the charioteer's son, glorious in battle, King Duryodhana always did what pleased him, and honored the best of brahmins with sacrifices with large gifts.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणां च प्रियं राजन्स चकार परंतपः ।
निश्चित्य मनसा वीरो दत्तभुक्तफलं धनम् ॥

meaning.en: And that scorcher of foes did what pleased his brothers, having resolved in his heart on giving, enjoying and fruit of wealth.
